## 1366a5f01eb6

**Finding A1 — declared exact control `divider_col` is ignored.** Generator SHA-256 `3a1833db335a6cb02ceeb1818b43e0be1779df0a28c6862f01cc708fb8d12b0c` declares `divider_col` in `AXES`, but generation chooses the divider with the unkeyed layout RNG and never consumes the override. With seed `917`, sample index `4`, and common overrides `grid_h=7, grid_w=9, n_left_cells=3`, requests `divider_col=1` and `divider_col=4` produce byte-identical validator-accepted grids; both realize the full-height gray column at 4.

Reproducer: `checks/audit/1366a5f01eb6/probe.py`  
Evidence: `checks/audit/1366a5f01eb6/probe.json` and `probe.log`

Impact: callers can believe they are balancing mirror-axis position while receiving no change. This also makes any axis-coverage claim based on requested values unreliable. Audit only; source left unchanged.
